entities.name: Yevgeny Katsura
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Yevgeny Katsura was a Russian weightlifter. Between 1962 and 1966 he won one world and two European titles, twice finishing in second place; he also set nine world records: seven in the press and two in the total.
